subject.title: Support installing all skills/plugins from a publisher

question: Should ClawHub add a publisher-wide install workflow, and if so what command namespace, item scope, confirmation model, and safety semantics should it use?
rationale: The source path is clear, but an install-all shortcut changes acquisition behavior across skills and plugins and needs maintainer intent around UX, compatibility, and safety before a repair PR is appropriate.

options.title: Design guarded publisher install
options.body: Add a preview-first publisher install flow only after maintainers define skill/plugin filters, per-item checks, confirmation, pagination snapshotting, and partial-failure behavior.

options.title: Fold into CLI taxonomy RFC
options.body: Treat this as part of https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2317 so namespace and aliases are decided before implementation.

options.title: Decline bulk install
options.body: Keep publisher pages/listing APIs as discovery-only and require users to install individual skills/plugins intentionally.

recommendation.title: Design guarded publisher install
recommendation.body: Add a preview-first publisher install flow only after maintainers define skill/plugin filters, per-item checks, confirmation, pagination snapshotting, and partial-failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is both the requester and the strongest recent history owner for the affected CLI, publisher, and docs surfaces.
